title: Barnette’s Hamiltonian-cycle conjecture

result.label: Barnette’s Hamiltonian-cycle conjecture
result.statement: Proves that every finite simple cubic bipartite planar 3-vertex-connected graph has a Hamiltonian cycle, resolving Barnette's conjecture. Equivalently, every three-edge path in a finite simple cubic 3-vertex-connected bipartite Pfaffian graph lies in a Hamiltonian cycle.
result.roleNote: The family's stated result in the release.
